item.title: The AI Agent Nobody Owns: Watch Expert Webinar On Your Newest Insider Threat
item.description:
Right now, there is probably an AI agent running on a laptop somewhere in your network. It stores API keys and database passwords, can access your internal systems, and works without anyone watching.
Nobody reviewed its access. Nobody owns it.
If an employee had that much reach with that little oversight, you would call it an insider risk. So why do we still call the agent a productivity tool?

item.title: Generative AI Is Erasing Behavioral Tells, Weakening Behavior-Only Detection, Proofpoint Reports
item.description:
Generative AI has changed what a malicious email looks like. Messages that once gave themselves away through clumsy wording, generic pretexts, and reused templates now arrive fluent, personalized, and unique to each recipient, and the behavioral signals email filters have relied on for years are fading as a result.
Proofpoint shared several examples of the shift at its Protect 2026 conference.
